text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa sustained an injury during training,
so I rushed her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry.
That things ended up like this.
choice_data_list: Injuries happen. For now, just take it easy and rest up.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um, about that...
Could you please let me
continue my training?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"In this world, there are many who suffer in solitude,
unable to even take a single step forward."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To become a beacon of hope for such people,
I have continued to run.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I feel like if I stop running now, even the hope that might someday connect us will be cut off...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So... please.
One who is meant to bring hope to everyone
must never be brought down by an injury.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Besides, if I show everyone that I can overcome this injury, I'm sure it will become a great beacon of hope.
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself like that won't inspire hope.
If it gets too tough, just tell me and I'll stop.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: However, Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Why not show them you can overcome your impatience?
How about showing them how you can overcome your impatience?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Overcoming impatience……

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Enduring with faith so that it will one day lead to hope is important, too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will take some time to rest now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —So that I can become a beacon of hope once more.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
For the sake of the Trainer who believed in me,
I'll be sure to carry this forward to the next stage.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: This is as far as we go.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Even though you indulged my selfishness,
I am truly, truly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa's injury worsened,
forcing her to take absolute rest.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. It seems this level of exercise
poses no issues at all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep going at this pace.
We don't have any time to stand still.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa continued with a reasonable
training regimen, making a smooth recovery.
